title: No new required-tech-story marker replaces the old one
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. Lines with and without required tech stories.
  5. Existing coverage: app/src/components/ts/work-orders/work-order-lines/tests/WorkOrderLineRow.spec.ts › “renders the story text without a check mark for a line with a tech story”, “renders only the add-story prompt for a line with $label”
custom_steps:
1. Review the line list for any new tech-story indicator.
  2. Confirm none was added by this change.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • No replacement required-tech-story indicator is added by this change (any such indicator would need its own spec).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10051 — Story 8 Remove tech-story check-mark. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options (Draft Spec)”, Draft v0.9, requirement(s) S8-E1 (read 23 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 23 September 2026; not yet build-verified.
